blocks.text: West Central Maple Ridge at a glance
Haney Place Exchange Buses downtown

parts.t: Haney Place is served by 791, 749, 748, 746, 745, 744, 743, 741, 733, 701 and R3, according to TransLink’s route diagram for it.

I only checked timetable dates for these routes. Routes 701, 743 and 745 are effective January 1, 2024. Route 744 is effective June 8, 2026, while 746 and 748 are effective April 20, 2026, and 791 is effective April 21, 2025. The news post from TransLink on August 24, 2026 says improvements to service on routes 701, 745 and 746 begin September 7, 2026, so please look at the current timetable.
The Town Centre Area Plan describes the Town Centre as anchored by the Haney Transit Exchange and Port Haney Station

blocks.text: Planning and flood notes for West Central Maple Ridge

parts.t: Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.

The Town Centre Area Plan dates from its first adoption in November 2008. When the City updated it in 2025, the plan boundary grew to take in River Bend, the land use designations dropped from 11 to 7, and a Town Centre Core designation was added for higher densities.

The City adopted its Transit-Oriented Area Designation Bylaw No. 8001-2024 on June 25, 2024. Two of its three areas, the Haney Transit Exchange and Port Haney Station, fall within the Town Centre Area Plan.

Updates to the Official Community Plan were adopted in 2025, according to the City, along with updates to area plans for Albion, Silver Valley, Hammond and the Town Centre. October 28 was the date for Albion’s, and the rest followed in November.
The Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan, adopted on January 27, 2026 as Official Community Plan Amending Bylaw No. 7781-2021, covers Lougheed Highway from Maple Meadows Way to 221 Street.

I found no official statement putting Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) land within West Central Maple Ridge. Because ALR status is decided parcel by parcel, the exact address needs checking on the Agricultural Land Commission map.
Properties close to the Fraser River floodplain get the City’s Be Flood Ready guide in the mail. Inside it are a map of that floodplain and an outline of the City’s flood response plan.
Floodplain maps from the City mark out the area expected to flood about once every 200 years on average, and the City publishes them for both the Fraser and Alouette rivers.
Flood risk is handled case by case, the City says, and its proposed Floodplain Management Bylaw would bring clearer rules, minimum building elevations among them.
The City’s Fraser River Escarpment policy area is bounded by 207 Street on the west, 124 Avenue on the north, 224 Street on the east and the crest of the Fraser River escarpment on the south.
I could not find a flood or slope statement covering West Central Maple Ridge as a whole. If an address is near the river in Port Haney, look at the floodplain map.

The proposed Langley–Haney Place Bus Rapid Transit line from TransLink would cover 22 km, with 13 stations and a bus every 10 minutes at peak. It is in detailed planning, TransLink says, and has preliminary funding from the 2025 Investment Plan, though more money is needed to deliver it.

blocks.text: Before you buy in West Central Maple Ridge

parts.t: Check the floodplain map for homes near the river.
Ask the City what the floodplain and escarpment rules mean for the exact address, especially for a basement or an addition.
Check what the Town Centre plan allows nearby.
New buildings can change a street, so ask the City what the plan designations permit on the lots around the home.
Ask SD42 for the exact address.
For a strata home, read the documents.
The depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees, plus any special levies.
Check the ALR on larger lots.
Look up the address on the Agricultural Land Commission map before you plan anything on farmland.
Check the roof, drainage, furnace, plumbing and wiring.

blocks.text: West Central Maple Ridge questions

parts.t: Where is West Central Maple Ridge?
West Central Maple Ridge is a name from the MLS® sub-areas, and the City of Maple Ridge has no boundary published for it.
The closest official description is the City’s Town Centre Area Plan, together with the City’s Town Centre and Port Haney neighbourhoods.
How do I get around from West Central Maple Ridge?
TransLink’s diagram of the routes at Haney Place shows R3 and 701, then 733, 741 and 743, then 744, 745 and 746, and finally 748, 749 and 791.

For these routes only, here are the timetable dates I checked: 744 took effect June 8, 2026; 746 and 748 took effect April 20, 2026; 791 took effect April 21, 2025; and 701, 743 and 745 took effect January 1, 2024. TransLink’s news post of August 24, 2026 also says routes 701, 745 and 746 get service improvements on September 7, 2026, so look at the current timetable.

Two West Coast Express stops serve Maple Ridge, at Maple Meadows Station and at Port Haney Station. Monday to Friday there are five trips daily: the train leaves Maple Ridge in the morning and comes back in the evening.
Port Haney Station is at 22300 River Road and has no parking.
Which schools are in West Central Maple Ridge?

The Province’s school list gives these addresses: Fairview Elementary, 12209 206 Street; Laity View Elementary, 21023 123 Avenue; Maple Ridge Elementary, 20820 River Road; Eric Langton Elementary, 12138 Edge Street; Maple Ridge Secondary, 21911 122 Avenue; Westview Secondary, 20905 Wicklund Avenue; and Thomas Haney Secondary, 23000 116 Avenue.
Catchments are set by address, so confirm a specific address with
What parks, recreation and library are there?
In the downtown core, on 224 Street, Memorial Peace Park sits next to the ACT Arts Centre, the Leisure Centre and City Hall.
The Maple Ridge Leisure Centre is at 11925 Haney Place.
Maple Ridge has just one Fraser Valley Regional Library branch, the Maple Ridge Public Library, located at 130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road.
What plan covers West Central Maple Ridge?
The Town Centre Area Plan was first adopted in November 2008 and updated on November 25, 2025.

The City adopted its Transit-Oriented Area Designation Bylaw No. 8001-2024 on June 25, 2024. Two of its three areas, the Haney Transit Exchange and Port Haney Station, fall within the Town Centre Area Plan.
Is West Central Maple Ridge in a floodplain?
The Fraser and Alouette rivers each have a floodplain map from the City, and the City also sends the Be Flood Ready guide out to properties near the Fraser River floodplain.
I found no flood statement written for West Central Maple Ridge as an area.
Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.
What are the homes and lots like?
In the 2021 Census the Town Centre had 6,520 households and about 12,430 residents, the City says, and the plan for the Town Centre is aiming for a denser, mixed-use downtown.
